name: Lindsey Wilson College
academic_ranking: Private four-year, not-for-profit liberal arts college affiliated with the United Methodist Church. Located in Columbia, KY. Offers undergraduate and graduate programs with a strong emphasis on counseling and human development. No specific national academic ranking captured from official sources.
financial_aid: More than 99% of undergraduate students receive some form of financial assistance, per the Lindsey Wilson College admissions site. Full cost-of-attendance (FY27, 9-month resident budget) totals approximately $49,329 including housing, food, fees and indirect costs. Athletic scholarships available as an NAIA program.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at the Lindsey Wilson Softball Complex on the Columbia, KY campus. A dedicated Softball Complex facilities page is linked on the athletics site.
program_reputation: Competitive NAIA program in the Mid-South Conference; nationally ranked #17 (per NAIA/coaches ranking referenced on the athletics site during the 2026 cycle).
notes: Staff directory and roster checked 2026-07 at lindseyathletics.com/sports/softball/coaches and /roster/2026. The coaches page displays apparent name/email mismatches (e.g., head coach Callum Maskill shown with email pilgrimc@lindsey.edu; assistant Annabelle Sharber shown with ramireza@lindsey.edu), which suggests the email fields are misbound in the site template; therefore those two emails were NOT trusted/attributed and left empty. Shared department phone 270-384-8598 listed for head coach and assistant. Team X/Twitter account is @LWUsoftball; no verified individual staff handles listed.
